title: Dual Shell-like Magnetic Clusters Containing Ni(II) and Ln(III) (Ln = La, Pr, and Nd) Ions

synthesis.procedure: Mix the metal nitrates and iminodiacetic acid in deionized water, adjust to approximately pH 4 with aqueous NaOH, and heat in a sealed Teflon-lined stainless-steel container at 180 °C for 100 h. Cool at 3 °C h−1 to 100 °C, hold for 16 h, then cool at the same rate to room temperature. Filter off insoluble residue and allow the blue filtrate to evaporate at room temperature.

reagents.name: Sodium hydroxide
reagents.amount: 1.0 M aqueous solution; volume not reported

synthesis.time: 100 h at 180 °C; 16 h at 100 °C; crystals after approximately 3 months of evaporation
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Hydrothermal synthesis in a sealed 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel container
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Remove insoluble residue by filtration; evaporate the blue filtrate at room temperature to obtain dark-blue cubic crystals.

properties.summary: Magnetic susceptibility indicates ferromagnetic coupling between Ni(II) ions and an estimated high-spin ground state of S = 20.

measurements.name: Curie–Weiss temperature

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, Magnetic Studies; Figure 16

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: An outer icosidodecahedral shell of 30 Ni(II) ions encloses a dodecahedral shell of 20 La(III) ions.
